summary: Test closing a milestone by logging in, navigating to the project 'test', accessing the milestones tab, and clicking on the first milestone to close it.

steps.expected_result: Login page displayed with title 'Login @ Collabtive'
Redirected to Desktop page with title 'Desktop @ Collabtive' and URL 'http://collabtive-old.local:8084/index.php?mode=login'
Navigated to project overview page for project 'test' with title 'Project test @ Collabtive' and URL 'http://collabtive-old.local:8084/manageproject.php?action=showproject&id=1'
Navigated to Milestones page with title 'Milestones @ Collabtive' and URL 'http://collabtive-old.local:8084/managemilestone.php?action=showproject&id=1'
Milestone closed (no page reload, but milestone status updated; page remains on same URL and title)
